title: ADBC Scanner
subtitle: Database drivers. Arrow batches. Ordinary SQL.
intro: Connect DuckDB to a database through an Arrow Database Connectivity driver. Use attached catalogs for joins and discovery, send backend SQL explicitly, or bulk-ingest a DuckDB query through the driver's Arrow interface.

reference.name: ATTACH … (TYPE adbc)
reference.description: Open a catalog; pass its alias to the functions below.

reference.name: adbc_scan(db, sql)
reference.description: Execute backend SQL; supply params and columns when needed.

reference.name: adbc_scan_table(db, table)
reference.description: Read a table with schema discovery and supported pushdown.

reference.name: CALL adbc_execute(db, sql)
reference.description: Run backend DDL or DML; return affected-row count.

reference.name: adbc_insert(db, table, query)
reference.description: Ingest Arrow batches; modes include create, append and replace.

reference.name: adbc_schema(db, table)
reference.description: Describe a named table, rather than an arbitrary query.

reference.name: CALL adbc_clear_cache()
reference.description: Refresh attached catalog metadata after remote DDL changes.

reference.name: SET adbc_allowed_drivers = 'sqlite'
reference.description: Allow only listed drivers; profiles and search_paths are then refused.

notes.title: Sandbox the drivers
notes.body: ATTACH loads a native driver library into the process and is refused while enable_external_access is false. Set adbc_allowed_drivers, then lock_configuration, before running untrusted SQL. Install the ADBC driver manifest or shared library separately.

notes.title: Schemas and transactions
notes.body: SQLite needs explicit columns for arbitrary scans. BEGIN / COMMIT controls the attachment's remote transaction, not a distributed one. Use a file for SQLite catalog scans. Cancelling a query cancels the remote statement; passwords show as *** in duckdb_databases() and errors.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN current_setting('adbc_allowed_drivers') = 'sqlite' THEN true ELSE error('adbc_allowed_drivers was not set') END;
